يستحجبوا (form X)
# يَسْتَحْجِبُوا (yastaḥjibū) /jas.taħ.d͡ʒi.buː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحْجَبَ (istaḥjaba)
# يُسْتَحْجَبُوا (yustaḥjabū) /jus.taħ.d͡ʒa.buː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحْجَبَ (istaḥjaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
